resources.string: Activity history
Entries explain what Hovq, the VPS, and Horizon did. Open an entry to read more, see its code, or show the other entries from the same job.
Technical details
Error
Warning
VPS setup
Server agent
Scheduler
Delivery
Horizon requests posts from enabled sources and checks for duplicate publications.
Horizon selects a processing profile for each item. AI evaluates the item using that profile.
Horizon applies profile thresholds, checks repeated topics, and enforces the group and issue limits.
Horizon requests additional context for an article or for selected items in automatic mode.
Horizon prepares the selected issue language and assembles the digest text.
The server writes the prepared issue to storage so that Hovq can download it.
Horizon attempts to send the digest to the configured email or webhook endpoints.

Agent availability check
Agent installation
The installer completed this step successfully.
The installer is working on this step. Check the following events for the result.
Agent is ready
The agent responded to the installer availability check.
The installer could not complete this step. Open the VPS setup screen to see the installation report.
Queued · %1$s
The server accepted the request. The job will start when the worker is ready.
Job finished
The agent completed the job. Open the related entries to see the individual results.
Job failed
Open the events for this job and look for the earliest error. It points to the stage that stopped.
Stopping a job
The agent received a request to stop the job. Check its final status to confirm.
The job was cancelled. You can start a new one when needed.
Job interrupted
A server or agent restart interrupted the job. Start it again if the result is missing.
The job reached its time limit. Check connectivity and the related entries before retrying.
Horizon started preparing additional context for an article.
Additional context was saved. Open the article to read it.
Horizon did not save additional context. Check the related entries and try again from the article.
Requested item is unavailable
The job, issue, or article is unavailable for this action. Refresh the server data and open it again.
Source checked
Horizon received publications from the source.
Publications received at this stage: %1$d.
No new items from the source
The source responded, but returned no items for this request. Check the time window and source filters if you expected new posts.
Some source requests failed
Some materials arrived. Check related source errors to see why other requests failed.
Source request failed
Horizon did not receive materials from this request. Check the address, access, and result of a source test.
The VPS accepted the schedule. Open Schedule to see the next run.
Scheduled run skipped
The planned time arrived while another job was active. The scheduler skipped this occurrence.
The agent could not process a scheduled run. Verify the schedule and the agent status on the VPS.
Server configuration
The agent validated and saved the settings. New jobs use the saved configuration.
The agent restored the previous saved configuration.
The agent found and prepared %1$d cover entries for the issue.
The issue cover list was prepared on the VPS.
The agent could not prepare or return a cover. The article text is still available if it was downloaded.
Additional context was unavailable. Horizon can still publish the base article from the first analysis.
The retry filled in translations missing from the initial response.
The agent prepared an encrypted backup. Hovq saves it to the file you choose.
The agent applied the settings from the encrypted file.
The requested journal entries were removed.
Background checking or notification delivery failed. Check connection and notification settings.
AI did not return a usable profile selection. Horizon continued with a fallback profile.
Check the chosen model and provider. Articles may show available original text if a translation failed.
Open Settings → Server → Connection to check access to the VPS and its agent.
Open the settings you last edited, check the selected values and links to profiles, then try saving again.
Open the other records for this job to see what happened before and after this event.
Check the provider, key, and model in AI processing. Run a model test before repeating the job.
Android could not access the protected connection storage. Unlock the phone and reopen Hovq.
The active agent does not support this backup format or Horizon version.
A connected service returned an error. The records from the same job help identify which stage failed.
The agent could not accept the request. Refresh the server state and check the values before retrying.
Problem during the operation
This entry does not contain a readable cause. Check the earlier events and the technical code below.
This entry only provides a technical code. Related records can show what led to it.
